title: THE RUN CARD SCROLLBAR STAYS INSIDE ITS CORNERS
why: From the 4K screenshot pass (V-E4): on a run card long enough to scroll, the scrollbar ran right to the top and bottom edges and poked out past the rounded corners. Its track now keeps a margin, so it stays inside the card.
now: On a long run card, the scrollbar now stays inside the rounded corners.

edits.anchor: .ocwin{ max-height:min(86vh,calc(100% - 32px)); }   /* v18.97: and the card always fits inside the screen, at any menu zoom */
edits.replacement:
.ocwin{ max-height:min(86vh,calc(100% - 32px)); }   /* v18.97: and the card always fits inside the screen, at any menu zoom */
  .ocwin::-webkit-scrollbar-track{ margin:16px 0; }   /* v16.xx, from the 4K visual pass (V-E4): on a run card that scrolls, the scrollbar stays inside the rounded corners */
